audit_boundary: Read-only static reconciliation. Eligibility is not completion credit and does not assert a benchmark/no-match outcome for any unreviewed split, regrouped or candidate target.

formal_completion_credit.reason: A consistent durable 895-row stable-ID manifest and target-by-target evidence mapping have not been integrated. The 260 figure is inheritance eligibility only.

inheritance_rules.DIRECT_RETAINED_UNIT: Require exact final target ID equality with the old adjudication unit, retained source-family lineage, unchanged semantic scope and complete carried evidence. Only verified-benchmark or documented-no-credible-match outcomes may inherit.
inheritance_rules.EXACT_ENVELOPE_RENAME: Require exactly one source family, one old unit and one final target with the same user job and envelope; preserve the old evidence plus explicit one-to-one rename provenance.
inheritance_rules.SPLIT_REGROUP_MERGE_OR_CANDIDATE: Do not inherit mechanically. Perform target-specific candidate research. A broader ancestor is context only and cannot enter the numerator.
inheritance_rules.PENDING_OR_REJECT: Never count as benchmark or documented no-credible-match completion.
inheritance_rules.BENCHMARK_EVIDENCE: Require an official repository, pinned commit SHA and exact source locus.
inheritance_rules.NO_CREDIBLE_MATCH_EVIDENCE: Require target-specific searches, rejected-candidate evaluations and no selected matching repository.

unavailable_checksum: No final target/status/source-unit/evidence-locus checksum is issued because the durable final mapping does not yet exist.
